purpose: User-authorized Paladin citizen and soldier assets
prompts: Create a production source SPRITE ATLAS for Paladin, using the attached approved character concept ONLY as the style reference. Deliver transparent background, no text, no labels, no lines, no shadows, no ground, no scenery. Exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows, evenly spaced identical cells, one small whole character centered in each cell with ample transparent padding. Columns are male front, male back, female front, female back, respectively. Rows: 1 general citizen in cream tunic; 2 wheat farmer with straw hat and tiny grain bundle; 3 fisher in blue tunic with small fishing tool; 4 logger in brown with small axe; 5 herder in green with shepherd crook; 6 baker in cream apron and white cap. Front/back refer to south/north-facing overhead strategy-game sprite views. ALL people share compact chunky proportions and same body height. Female version has slightly longer hair/tied back hair visible from back; same clothes and equipment as male, no exaggerated anatomy. Each character must resemble a genuinely LOW RESOLUTION sprite with approximately 9-pixel-wide by 12-pixel-high body, presented enlarged using nearest-neighbor square blocks; tools may extend 2 pixels. No details smaller than a block, no realistic faces, no painted texture, no gradients, no antialiasing, no outline grid. The approved reference is already the desired shape language. Keep heads/shoulders seen from overhead and simple legs; only slightly larger than the reference's tiny sprite. Use ONLY these Paladin palette source colors: cream #F4E7C7 #D9C79F, skin #F3B69A #CB7C70 #B78350, leather/hair #B78350 #7A5038 #49352F, straw #EBC46B #BD864C, green #79B56D #337A58 #235747, blue #46627D #30455D, iron #D7E0E3 #9AA7AF #6C747A, outline #392B3C. Exact 4 by 6 rectangular atlas, entire heads, feet, and tools inside each cell, no touching or shared pieces. Clean transparent background. This is source artwork for extraction, not a concept presentation board.
